bootstrap.interval: one-sided centered/basic bootstrap: for statistic T and deviations d_b=T_b-T_hat, LCB=T_hat-quantile_0.95(d_b), UCB=T_hat-quantile_0.05(d_b). Do not use percentile lower bounds for nonnegative sup norms.
bootstrap.resampling: paired whole trajectories using common seed indices

formula.bootstrap_rule: Recompute each common Q inside each paired whole-trajectory bootstrap replicate using the resampled dense means and fixed PDE curves.
formula.gram: Q_G=max(0.05, max over all five primary PDE and dense curves of sup_{t,s} ||Delta G(s,t)||_F).
formula.loss: Q_L=max(0.05, max over all five primary PDE and dense curves of sup_t L(t)).
formula.output: Q_f=max(0.05, max over all five primary PDE and dense curves of sup_t ||Delta f(t)||_2).

scientific_question: Does the fixed P=5 PDE track activation-specific nonlinear dynamics better than deep-linear null curves?
